d:
Bihar ke darbhanga men 62 kilo chandi ki lut ka mamla ab rajnitik rang lene laga hai. pulis ne is mamle men panch aaropiyon ko giraphtar kiya hai. inmen ek nam vishal mahaseth urph vikki ka bhi hai. vishal bijepi ka sakriy karyakarta raha hai aur darbhanga nagar men parti ka mahamantri bhi rah chuka hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
